# <span id="aanchor226"></span> Manage Close Groups

Once a meter is assigned to a close group, the button to the right of the drop-down becomes enabled which provides access to the Manage Close Groups screen.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 348;height: 67;" />

The Manage Close Groups screen displays all the close groups a meter belongs to. You can use this screen to assign a meter to more than one close group during different time periods.

<div class="procedure">

To assign a different close group to a meter:

1.  From the Meter Editor, click button next to the Close Groups drop-down on the General tab, or go to **Tools** \> **Manage Close Groups**.
2.  Click **Edit**. A new row will display.
3.  Select a start month and end month. Click in each field to manually type in a year.
4.  Click **OK** to apply the changes. The start and end month for the other close group assignments are automatically adjusted based on the changes.
5.  Click **Save** and **Exit** to return to the Meter Editor. To discard the changes, click **Cancel** and **Exit**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 615;height: 431;" />

</div>
